title: Ask an agent why your workouts have stalled
summary: A lifter connected three years of Caliber workout logs to an AI assistant and says it spotted patterns behind stalled lifts, producing a plan to test.
agent_role: The assistant pulled the user's logged workout history through Caliber's connector and analyzed it for patterns; the user asked the questions and will run the experiments.
outcome: Author reports finding patterns he had missed and ending with a concrete plan to break plateaus.
what_they_did: The poster has logged every workout for three years in the Caliber app, including sets and rest times. Caliber released a connector for ChatGPT and Claude. He used it to ask an AI about his training history, looking for patterns and reasons some lifts had stalled.
how_it_went: He says the insights were impressive and pointed to things he had not noticed. He now has a concrete plan to experiment with.
worth_knowing: The value comes from the data: he stresses that years of consistent logging is what made the analysis useful.
prompt: Using my connected workout log from [your fitness app], review my training history for the last [time period]. Focus on [exercises where I've stalled]. Look for patterns in volume, frequency, rest times and exercise order that might explain the plateau. Summarize what you find with specific examples from my data, then suggest a [number]-week experiment plan to break through. Keep it within my schedule of [days per week] sessions.

curation.rationale: Genuine use of an AI assistant connected to three years of workout logs to diagnose plateaus; personal and health-related but light on specifics and results.
